Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for applying and for your time last week. We’d like to move you to the panel interview for Backend Engineer (IC3). Below are the proposed slots — please let me know which one works and I’ll lock it in: 

• Tue 3/21, 10:00–11:00 PT
• Tue 3/21, 14:00–15:00 PT
• Wed 3/22, 09:30–10:30 PT

The loop will include technical (Jonas), system design (Mina), and a brief culture fit with me. We plan to run it via Zoom; if you prefer a take-home exercise instead we can accommodate that.

Attached: resume_ethan_cole.pdf (from profile), panel_availability.ics (proposed).

Best,
Lauren Bishop

lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Quick update from my side — I’m expecting an internet outage at home on 3/21 due to planned maintenance from the provider (confirmed window 14:00–17:00 PT). I can do the 16:30 PT backup if the outage is wrapped early, but there’s a decent chance I’ll be offline for parts of that window.

Options I’d suggest:
1) Move the panel to another day (I’m free Thu 3/23 10:00–12:00 PT).
2) Run a hybrid: Jonas and Mina do the live portion, I join by phone if the connection allows (I can dial in).
3) Convert to take-home + short async debrief (we review the submission and run a 30-min sync for culture fit).

If the candidate prefers take-home given his rehearsal, and with my outage risk, conversion feels reasonable. Thoughts?

— Stephanie

Hi Lauren / team —

I’m really sorry for the flurry of updates — this morning I woke up with a fever and ran an at-home rapid test which came back positive. I’m following public-health guidance and don’t want to risk exposing anyone. Given my rehearsal + now feeling under the weather, I’d prefer to convert to the take-home we discussed. Would 48 hours be an acceptable turnaround? If you need proof, I can attach a quick photo of the test.

If a take-home is fine, please send the instructions and any timeboxed constraints — I’ll submit as soon as I’m able. If you’d rather postpone the loop until I’m recovered, I understand that as well.

Thanks for being flexible,
Ethan

[Attachment: covid_test_photo.jpg (JPEG)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Ethan —

Thanks for letting us know and I’m sorry to hear you’re unwell. Please prioritize rest and recovery. We are happy to convert to the take-home. Here’s the plan:

• We’ll send the take-home exercise PDF (attached) and ask for a 48-hour turnaround from when you’re able to start.
• Please submit via reply or a GitHub gist and include a short (3–5 bullet) writeup of design trade-offs.
• Once we receive it, Jonas and Mina will review asynchronously and schedule a 30-min sync for clarifying questions / culture fit (we’ll be flexible on times — likely the following week).

If you’d prefer to reschedule the live loop instead of doing the take-home, let me know and we’ll reopen availability. Otherwise I’ll send the take-home instructions now.

Take care,
Lauren Bishop
Recruiter, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: takehome-instructions.pdf (PDF)]
